parts.html: The K-44 kitchen is a modern minimalist L-shaped kitchen: gray-beige fronts, wood-look upper cabinets, and a countertop and backsplash with a stone-effect decor. The palette is restrained, and the wood above adds warmth.

The main fronts are light gray-beige, somewhere between warm beige and cool gray. The tall units and base cabinets are in this color, while the upper row stands out: warm gray-brown wood with a visible grain.
Layout and dimensions
The layout is L-shaped: the work surface runs along two adjacent walls, the corner is not wasted, and the cooking, washing, storage, and built-in appliance zones are conveniently distributed.
Along the two walls, the kitchen runs 5.3 linear meters. The standard model measures 5.3 × 2.5 × 0.6 m overall.

In the visualization, the work area is in the center and in the corner. On the right is a tall block for built-in appliances: it houses the oven and microwave, so the appliances stay in line with the fronts.
Tall pantry units add storage space: they hold separate sections for large kitchenware, food, and appliances. We will decide where they go in your kitchen when we adapt the model to the room.
Front and carcass materials
The K-44 upper and lower fronts are made of different materials.
The lower fronts are MDF-based acrylic panels with a smooth surface, a good material for minimalist furniture with simple shapes.
The upper fronts are laminated chipboard, shown in the visualization with a wood-grain decor that contrasts with the light lower part.
The carcass is made of 18 mm thick laminated chipboard.
Countertop and work area
The standard K-44 countertop is chipboard-based; the stone texture is a decorative finish, not natural stone.
In the visualization, it has a gray-brown stone decor with light veining. The wall panel has the same pattern, so the work area reads as a single whole.
Hardware
The standard hinges are Muller Profi Line with soft-close, so the doors close smoothly.
Drawers run on the Muller Box Profi Line system.
A cargo pull-out is part of the standard configuration: the pull-out section is a convenient place for food, bottles, jars, and other small kitchen items.
Handles are included. In the visualization, they are dark like the profiles and stand out clearly against the light fronts.
The upper cabinets in the standard version have no lift-up mechanisms.
Built-in appliances
The K-44 kitchen is designed for built-in appliances.
We plan niches for the oven, microwave, refrigerator, cooktop, and other appliances into the design from the start.
The appliances themselves are not included in the base furniture price — on request, we can help you choose them, as well as a range hood, sink, faucet, and plumbing fixtures.
What the standard configuration includes
The base furniture set includes carcasses, toe kicks, fronts, the countertop, fasteners, cabinet hardware, hinges, pull-out elements, a dish drying rack, and handles.
Lighting can be added separately; its cost depends on the configuration, the type of lighting, and the size of the kitchen.
What can be changed
The K-44 is a production model, but it can be reworked to fit a specific room.
We change the dimensions of individual sections, the cabinet arrangement, the layout of the tall pantry units, the places for built-in appliances, and the cabinet interiors.
The finish can be changed too: the mix of light and wood-grain fronts, the wood shade, the color of the solid surfaces, and the countertop pattern.

On request, we fit higher-grade hardware, extra mechanisms, and storage systems, and make the fronts, countertop, and interiors from other materials — cheaper or more expensive than the standard ones. These options are priced separately.
K-44 kitchen technical specifications
Front color: Gray; visually — light gray-beige with a wood accent
Style: Minimalist
Layout: L-shaped
Countertop type: Chipboard-based
Overall dimensions: 5.3 × 2.5 × 0.6 m
Length: 5.3 linear m
Lift-up mechanism: None
Island: No
Cargo pull-out: Yes
Appliance installation type: Built-in
Handles: Included
Upper front type: Laminated chipboard, wood-grain decor
Lower front type: MDF-based acrylic panel
Carcass type: Laminated chipboard, 18 mm
Hinges: Muller Profi Line soft-close
Slide / drawer system type: Muller Box Profi Line
Decor: Solid-color in the base specification, with a wood accent in the visual concept
Additional features shown in the visualization: Light tall pantry units, wood-grain upper row, stone-effect countertop and backsplash, built-in oven and microwave, dark profile elements.
We will calculate the price of the K-44 once we have confirmed the dimensions, materials, and configuration of your kitchen.
